title: Prospective observational study on wearable-based monitoring of patients in hip and knee arthroplasty
summary:
During the hospital stay, patients who receive an artificial knee or hip joint are monitored with a comfortable wristband (wearable). The device measures heart rate, breathing rate, body temperature, and movement. These measurements are compared with those from the conventional, wired monitoring system.
In addition, aspects such as satisfaction, acceptance, digital challenges, workload, and wearing comfort for both patients and nursing staff are assessed.

interventions.name: In patients undergoing elective knee or hip arthroplasty, vital parameters are measured perioperatively until discharge using a wearable device, with real-time data transmission to the nursing station.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
elective total hip or knee replacement
Exclusion criteria:
missing consent
